ModMetaData.author: sunny
ModMetaData.description:
Version: 1.6.01\n Unofficial 1.6 continuation of JKV's Rakkle mod, with RimVore-2 integration. ==Rakkle the rattle snake==
Rakkles are reptilian humanoids originally found on a remote planet in the Rim. After their discovery, human colonies rounded them up and delivered them to a corporation known only as The Cradle, which first gave them near-human intelligence, and then reshaped them into living products - docile, calculating predators engineered from the ground up to swallow, hold and digest other living beings. Their aggression was dulled and their appetites sharpened so the goods would never bite the hand that sells them. They were also modified to give birth to females more often than males, creating a biological need for species interbreeding. The newly created Rakkle species were managed by The Cradle beyond the reaches of the galaxy, while wild Rakkle were hunted and killed to protect the company's interest. Future generations within the facilities were conditioned and raised as slaves, livestock and toys. After a series of escapes and revolts on planet after planet, a coalition of freed Rakkle began colonies of their own, resisting capture and invasion to create a new world where Rakkle can live outside the yoke of slavery. Despite The Cradle's best efforts, these settlements continue to grow in size and number.
== Race Characteristics ==
- Shedding: Rakkle shed periodically.
-- Advantages -- - Born to devour: Rakkle were engineered to engulf prey several times their own size, hold it inside their bodies, and digest it with startling speed. To a rakkle, swallowing a struggling creature whole is as natural as breathing. - Fast movement speed: Rakkle move faster than humans. Other species will have a hard time escaping a rakkle chase. - Melee Battle Bonus: Rakkle have higher melee combat capability than humans. They are stronger than humans in combat, whether with guns or bare hands, due to their use of teeth and tails. - Strong tail: Rakkle have no legs. Instead, they have a large tail that is stronger than a human leg. - Long meal cycle: Rakkle can retain a maximum of 5 calories. If they eat raw meat balls, a rakkle food, they can last for about 5 days. *Caution: If rakkle are not fed raw meat balls, they will lose this advantage. - High maximum adaptive temperature: Rakkle can withstand hot weather. - Permanent immunity to food poisoning.
-- Weaknesses -- - Carnivorous: Rakkle are carnivores and do not like eating vegetables. Cooked meals can be consumed, but with a mood disadvantage. - Different organ locations: The heart, kidney, and liver of rakkle are located in the upper tail. While the upper tail protects their organs, it also increases their vulnerability. - Very slow cultivation: Rakkle develop significantly slower than humans. - High probability of food poisoning: When rakkle cook, there is a higher chance of causing food poisoning compared to humans. - High minimum adaptive temperature: Rakkle are very vulnerable to cold environments. - Predation dependency: an engineered metabolism demands live prey. Go too long without digesting someone and a Rakkle begins to weaken.
== Rakkle Mechanics (RimVore-2) ==
- Engineered traits as genes: several Rakkle traits - food poisoning immunity, predatory compulsion, predation growth, the predation toolkit and predation dependency - are provided by real Biotech genes, so they can be inherited, extracted and transferred. - Engulfing tongue: a ranged ability that lashes out with an adhesive tongue and drags the victim back within reach. It cannot be crafted; a Rakkle grows it after digesting enough prey, then later upgrades to a longer, faster version. - Constriction charge: every Rakkle melee hit builds a constriction charge on the attacker. Once full, the Rakkle automatically seizes the victim in a RimVore-2 grapple. - Anesthetic needler: a craftable ranged weapon that fires darts coated in Rakkle venom, putting a struggling victim to sleep before it is swallowed.
== Contents == - Vanilla clothing is available. All clothing is tailored to fit their unique bodies! - Some species-specific clothing items - Two species-specific foods - Helmintics can be produced using snake skins (This can treat Gut worms and muscle parasites) - Race-specific backstories - Race-specific predation weapons - Rakkle Permanent Enemy Faction - Rakkle Friendship Faction (do not request support; they do not like fighting.)
== P.S. == - If you are using the apparel re-texture mod, I recommend using the following mod alongside it. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2037354634

================================ 中文说明 ================================
版本：1.6.01 JKV 拉克（响尾蛇）模组的 1.6 非官方续作，整合 RimVore-2。
== 设定 == 拉克种是原生栖息在“边缘”一颗偏远星球上的爬行类人型生物。在被人类殖民者发现并聚集起来后，它们被交给了那家名为“响尾蛇”的公司——后者先赋予了它们近乎人类的智力，随后更把它们彻底重塑为一种活体商品：温顺而精于算计的捕食者，从身体构造上就是为了吞下、容纳并消化其他活体生物而生的。它们的攻击性被削弱、食欲被强化，以确保这些“商品”不会反咬出售它们的手；它们还被改造为生育雌性的概率高于雄性，从而产生了跨物种繁衍的生物学需求。 在“响尾蛇”的设施中，一代又一代的拉克被驯化并被当作奴隶、牲畜和玩物养育，出售给任何出得起价钱的人。野生的拉克则遭到捕杀，以保护该公司的垄断。 在经历了各个星球上一系列逃亡与起义之后，一群获得自由的拉克建立了属于自己的殖民地，抵御抓捕与入侵，力图打造一个拉克能够摆脱奴隶制枷锁生活的新世界。尽管“响尾蛇”竭尽全力，这些定居点的规模和数量仍在持续增长。 == 物种特性 ==
- 蜕皮：拉克会定期蜕皮。
-- 优势 -- - 为吞噬而生：拉克能吞下数倍于自身体型的猎物，将其容纳在体内，并以惊人的速度消化。对拉克而言，活吞生物就像呼吸一样自然。 - 移动迅速：拉克比人类跑得更快，其他物种很难摆脱拉克的追击。 - 近战加成：凭借牙齿与尾巴，拉克的近战能力强于人类。 - 强力蛇尾：拉克没有双腿，取而代之的是一条粗壮有力的尾巴。 - 长餐周期：拉克最多可储存 5 点营养；食用拉克专属的生肉丸可维持约 5 天。 - 高温耐受：拉克能忍受炎热天气。 - 永久食物中毒免疫。
-- 弱点 -- - 食肉：拉克是食肉动物，不喜欢蔬菜；可食用熟食，但会带来心情惩罚。 - 器官异位：拉克的心脏、肾脏和肝脏位于上段尾部。 - 成长缓慢：拉克的发育速度明显慢于人类。 - 烹饪易中毒：拉克烹饪时更容易引发食物中毒。 - 低温畏惧：拉克非常惧怕寒冷环境。 - 吞噬依赖：经过改造的代谢渴求活体猎物，太久未能消化生物便会逐渐衰弱。
== 玩法机制（RimVore-2）==
- 特性基因化：若干拉克特性（食物中毒免疫、捕食冲动、捕食成长、捕食构造、吞噬依赖）由真正的 Biotech 基因提供，可被继承、提取与转移。 - 吞噬长舌：一种远程能力，甩出黏性长舌将受害者拽回身边；它无法被制造——拉克在消化足够猎物后会自行长出，之后还会升级为更长、更快的版本。 - 缠绕蓄势：拉克的每次近战命中都会为自身积累“缠绕蓄势”；蓄满后会自动对目标发起 RimVore-2 擒抱。 - 麻醉针枪：可制造的远程武器，发射涂有拉克毒液的飞针，让挣扎的猎物陷入沉睡后再将其吞下。
== 内容 ==
- 可用的原版服装（均经过裁剪以适配其独特体型） - 若干种族专属服装 - 两种种族专属食物 - 可用蛇皮制作的驱虫药（治疗肠道蠕虫与肌肉寄生虫） - 种族专属的背景故事 - 种族专属的捕食武器 - 拉克永久敌对派系 - 拉克友好派系（他们不喜欢战斗，请勿请求支援）
